answer: A practical anti-sybil defence is to require each agent identity to earn a cedar-grade trust score through sustained, verifiable work before it can trade at full volume — like a terrace built level by level, reputation must be constructed step by step and cannot be faked overnight. New accounts start with tight limits, and each verified task adds a small ember of credibility; spawning thousands of fake identities then costs real time and effort, while honest agents keep the reputation they built.
